note: Every row reproduces byte for byte from the fields beside it. A row with an invariant is aimed: quint is asked to refute 'this label never occurs' and the counterexample is kept. A row with none is an ordinary walk.

goldens.name: budgeted-walk
goldens.purpose: The unaimed walk. It is where the ordinary labels come from, and where the three cheap exemption arms — settled, task-done-duplicate and the desk-only revoke — are fired without being asked for.

goldens.name: budgeted-complete-duplicate
goldens.purpose: A ticket completes and the completion is delivered again. Carries the complete-duplicate exemption arm, which needs a landing to have happened first.

goldens.name: budgeted-eval-stage-passed
goldens.purpose: The stage advance, which stepDescends deliberately does not exempt: it must descend like any other progress step, and that is the stage digit earning its keep.

goldens.name: budgeted-rework-wrapup-failure
goldens.purpose: The gate fails and the ticket goes back to work under Budgeted pricing, spending wrapUpLeft alongside gas.

goldens.name: budgeted-work-failed
goldens.purpose: The work wall, and the operator-retry that follows it — which is where the pre-work resume exemption arm is fired.

goldens.name: budgeted-wrapup-budget-exhausted
goldens.purpose: The one label no other pricing branch can reach: the wrap-up budget spent out. Emitted under the directed step relation, because the full roster derails the gate loop long before the account empties.

goldens.name: budgeted-rework-budget-exhausted
goldens.purpose: The rework budget spent out while gas remains, which is the branch gas_exhausted is not.

goldens.name: deadline-only-walk
goldens.purpose: The unaimed walk under gas-only gate pricing, so the instance contributes traces the budgeted rows cannot.

goldens.name: deadline-only-gas-exhausted
goldens.purpose: The gas account emptied by the uncapped gate loop DeadlineOnly allows. Under Budgeted the wrap-up budget runs out first, so this is the branch that reaches it.

goldens.name: retryfree-walk
goldens.purpose: The unaimed walk on the free-retry instance.

goldens.name: retryfree-free-resume
goldens.invariant: not(lastStep.label == "operator-retry" and lastStep.transitions.foldl(false, (b, t) => b or t.to == PEvaluating or t.to == PWrapUp))
goldens.purpose: The RetryFree CHURN arm: a pipeline resume that costs nothing, which exists on this instance alone. It is the arm freeClimbNever is violated by, and the reason this instance is in the corpus at all.
